profile_text.body:
Cadence Design Systems Inc is a public company headquartered in San Jose, California, trading under the ticker CDNS, with SEC filings under CIK 0000813672. On its own website the company describes itself as a leading EDA and Intelligent System Design provider that delivers hardware, software, and IP for electronic design. The same site points to its culture, its inclusion on Fortune's 100 Great Places to Work, and its investment in sustainability.

The harvested site text does not name specific products or AI offerings, and no products or MCP servers are recorded for the company. Litigation records associated with Cadence list 281 cases in California, and no individual cases are listed.
